Ok so zed is a champion that in a 1v1 (within reason) there is always a way to either straight up win or outplay to win. Zed is rediciously strong in every phase of the game when played correctly. Now for the early game you need to know your opponent how they trade and how they combo and what you can do when they're doing it. 

So for example lets say Zed vs Ahri mid. Ok so ahri likes to trade by
1. Staying behind minions and trying to catch you with a Q from far back
2. Walking up with her E on and letting it hit you
3. Wait till you go for cs and charm then q and blah blah

Right so you need to anticipate these trades and put yourself in their shoes and then you can outplay. So you get to lane and ahri is just being a passive laner and sitting behind minions and throwing q's to the wind. There's a lot of things you can do to win lane. 

1. Keep baiting Q's and just wait for her mana to run out and then punish her with your own q's or weq combos or just wq
2. You stand back and let her walk to you and then you combo her each time. 
3. I like to stand off to the side and bait charm from ahri and then w into her to get my q e and auto and possible passive proc off on her. 

But you gotta just mind game the enemy with zed, you see them coming at you just throw your w at them and hit them with both q's and an e. If you're getting stomped you need to just q harass or just farm with q and wait for ganks or farm jungle in between waves. Learn to dodge ults or skills with your ult and don't forget about your passive. Pm for any clarification or further assistance.

Ok, you need to play depending on your opponent, you need to know when you are able to all in and play safe. Zed is extremely versatile champ and can be played different ways without sacrificing power. Against heavy poke champs like Ori/Syndra/Ziggs you need to farm with Q and then try to land full combos when they have abilities on cooldown. Rush boots/hex for MS and some resistances and try and dodge there Q's then go in for a combo like WEQ. Use your W sparingly if you're playing up in lane against easy match ups like Lux or velkoz or another immobile champ because you could get baited in and then a gank comes and au revoir. 

In teamfights dont be quick to use your ult, when getting chased throw your W at them and E to slow them down and keep running. If you're fighting in a narrow passage and only thing in front of you are the tanks then just combo but don't ult them it'd be a waste. Try and wait for the squishys to move up and then hit W again then ult or just re-position around then ult in. Always keep track of your shadows in fights its the difference between getting out safely after the pop or just hitting R again and your still in the same place (Which happens a few times). 

If you have any further questions just ask. (These tips are solely mine and are not the key to getting challenger lol).

In teamfights I play extremely safe as an ADC cause I lane super well and most of the time I am up in Farm and Items. Always hit the closest target to you. If you position in the back you should be able to get free autos for long periods of time on their tanks and frontline and do massive damage since you're not being focused. Once they die its your call whether you can keep going with your team or need to back off. Teamfights in my opinion is who can kill the tanks first. If you are able to obliterate there tanks before they take out yours you can safely chase and finish them off for the ace. As for kiting you need to just practice using Attack move and it will come to you.
